data.description: The 8 Station Multi Gym is our larger multi-station frame, finished in Ocean Grey, with eight exercise stations on one structure. It suits large parks, township clubhouses, college campuses and corporate grounds where many people exercise at the same time, especially in the early morning. Grouping the stations on one frame keeps the gym area tidy and easier to supervise and maintain than eight separate machines. Ask us for the list of eight stations and a drawing of the full layout. We will also confirm the warranty in writing; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Share your site photos and we will show where the 8 Station Multi Gym fits.

items.pText: The 8 Station Multi Gym is our larger multi-station frame, finished in Ocean Grey, with eight exercise stations on one structure. It suits large parks, township clubhouses, college campuses and corporate grounds where many people exercise at the same time, especially in the early morning. Grouping the stations on one frame keeps the gym area tidy and easier to supervise and maintain than eight separate machines. Ask us for the list of eight stations and a drawing of the full layout. We will also confirm the warranty in writing; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Share your site photos and we will show where the 8 Station Multi Gym fits.

Because eight people may be on the frame at once, this unit is grouted into a prepared base. Ocean Grey hides dust well on busy park sites. Plan clear circulation space around the frame, and check bearings, seat fixings and handles at each maintenance visit.
